declarations.description:
Application shell screen: top bar, optional rail, sidebar (project or mission) and the content column. The host owns
routing, data and persistence; the shell owns layout, the responsive tier and its own status. Render it full-bleed:
the tier follows the window width.

Not self-registering: `src/index.ts` defines the tag once.
declarations.name: SkMissionShell

members.name: tier
members.description:
Read-only: derived from the window width, re-asserted on every update. The current tier (`expanded`, `collapsed` or
`mobile`) is reflected on the host as the `tier` attribute and is public: a slotted screen may read it and observe its
changes, through `ShellTierController` (the Work Package screen shows one column in the mobile tier, where the content
cell is the whole viewport).

events.name: sk-toggle-drawer
events.description: the mobile drawer asks to open or close (cancelable)

events.name: sk-toggle-flyout
events.description: the collapsed-tier flyout asks to open or close (cancelable)

events.name: sk-shell-retry
events.description: the error-state retry button was activated The content slot is a flex column (the slotted screen may `flex-grow` to fill it; inline children are blockified). `main` pads the content by `--sk-mission-shell-content-padding` (24px, 16px at the mobile tier); that property is public: a slotted screen that sets the `flush` attribute on the shell pads its own inset parts with it. `flush` removes the padding, so a screen can run to the edges of the content column (the Pipeline screen's inspector and phase band).
